question: What happened to calls to US poison centres about cleaners and disinfectants in early 2020?
answer: They rose by about a fifth on the same months of 2019, the CDC found. More cleaning meant more mistakes: products mixed, sprayed in closed rooms, used on food. One woman filled a sink with bleach, vinegar and hot water to soak her vegetables, breathed the fumes and was taken to hospital.
move: Doing more of a good thing also means doing more of its risks.
ask: When I'm anxious and doing more of something, am I also doing it less carefully?
reference: Chang et al., Cleaning and Disinfectant Chemical Exposures and Temporal Associations with COVID-19, MMWR 69(16):496–498, 2020
